select u.name, u.name as user_name, o.*, q.doc_no as quote_doc_no
from orders o
inner join users u on u.id = o.user_id
left join quotes q on o.quote_id = q.id
where o.is_sales = $1
order by o.id desc

SELECT 
    u.name, 
    u.name as user_name, 
    o.quote_id, 
    i.*, 
    o.doc_no as order_doc_no, 
    q.doc_no as quote_doc_no,
    COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_items
FROM invoices i 
    LEFT JOIN users u ON i.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN quotes q ON o.quote_id = q.id
WHERE i.is_sales IS $1 
  AND ($2 IS NULL OR $2 = 'all' OR i.type = $2)
  AND ($3 IS NULL OR i.user_id = $3)
  AND ($4 IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(i.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= $4)
  AND ($5 IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(i.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD')  <= $5)
  AND ($8 IS NULL OR i.doc_no ILIKE '%' || $8 || '%'
        OR u.name ILIKE '%' || $8 || '%')
ORDER BY i.id DESC
LIMIT $6
OFFSET (($7 - 1) * $6);

WITH all_transactions AS (
    -- BLOQUE 1: PAGOS DIRECTOS
    SELECT 
        p.id AS transaction_id,
        p.created_at,
        u.name AS user_name,
        p.doc_no AS transaction_doc_no,
        p.doc_no AS source_doc_no,
        i.doc_no AS invoice_doc_no,
        'direct_payment' AS transaction_type,
        ABS(COALESCE(p.converted_amount, p.amount)) AS amount_applied, 
        ABS(p.amount) AS source_amount,
        p.currency AS source_currency,
        p.exchange_rate,
        pm.name AS payment_method_name,
        pm.code AS payment_method_code,
        p.is_sales,
        p.doc_no,
        p.invoice_id,
        p.notes,
        p.is_historical,
        p.external_id,
        p.doctor_id
    FROM payments p
    INNER JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN invoices i ON p.invoice_id = i.id
    LEFT JOIN payment_methods pm ON p.payment_method_id = pm.id

    UNION ALL

    -- BLOQUE 2: ASIGNACIONES DE ANTICIPOS (BILLETERA VIRTUAL)
    SELECT 
        pa.id AS transaction_id,
        pa.created_at,
        u.name AS user_name,
        CONCAT(orig_p.doc_no, '-A', pa.id) AS transaction_doc_no, 
        orig_p.doc_no AS source_doc_no,
        i.doc_no AS invoice_doc_no,
        'payment_allocation' AS transaction_type,
        ABS(pa.target_amount) AS amount_applied,
        ABS(pa.amount) AS source_amount,
        orig_p.currency AS source_currency,
        pa.exchange_rate,
        pm.name AS payment_method_name,
        pm.code AS payment_method_code,
        orig_p.is_sales,
        null AS doc_no,
        pa.invoice_id,
        '' AS notes,
        false AS is_historical,
        null AS external_id,
        null AS doctor_id
    FROM payment_allocations pa
    JOIN payments orig_p ON pa.payment_id = orig_p.id
    LEFT JOIN invoices i ON pa.invoice_id = i.id
    LEFT JOIN users u ON i.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN payment_methods pm ON orig_p.payment_method_id = pm.id
    WHERE 
        (orig_p.invoice_id IS DISTINCT FROM pa.invoice_id)

    UNION ALL

    -- BLOQUE 3: ASIGNACIONES DE NOTAS DE CRÉDITO
    SELECT 
        ia.id AS transaction_id,
        ia.created_at,
        u.name AS user_name,
        CONCAT(nc.doc_no, '-A', ia.id) AS transaction_doc_no, 
        nc.doc_no AS source_doc_no,
        target_i.doc_no AS invoice_doc_no,
        'credit_note_allocation' AS transaction_type,
        ABS(ia.target_amount) AS amount_applied,
        ABS(ia.amount) AS source_amount,
        nc.currency AS source_currency,
        ia.exchange_rate,
        'Credit Note' AS payment_method_name,
        'CN' AS payment_method_code,
        TRUE AS is_sales,
        null AS doc_no,
        ia.target_id AS invoice_id,
        '' AS notes,
        false AS is_historical,
        null AS external_id,
        null AS doctor_id
    FROM invoice_allocations ia
    JOIN invoices nc ON ia.source_id = nc.id
    JOIN invoices target_i ON ia.target_id = target_i.id
    JOIN users u ON target_i.user_id = u.id
),
filtered_data AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER() as total_items
    FROM all_transactions
    WHERE is_sales = $1
      AND (user_name ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%' 
           OR transaction_doc_no ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%' 
           OR source_doc_no ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%'
           OR invoice_doc_no ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%')
      AND (
        $7 IS NULL OR $7 = 'all'
        OR ($7 = 'prepaid'          AND transaction_type = 'direct_payment'  AND invoice_id IS NULL)
        OR ($7 = 'direct_payment'   AND transaction_type = 'direct_payment'  AND invoice_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR ($7 = 'payment_allocation'      AND transaction_type = 'payment_allocation')
        OR ($7 = 'credit_note_allocation'  AND transaction_type = 'credit_note_allocation')
      )
)
SELECT * FROM filtered_data
WHERE 
  ($5 IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= $5)
  AND ($6 IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= $6)
ORDER BY created_at DESC, transaction_id DESC
LIMIT $3 OFFSET ($4 - 1) * $3;

SELECT u.name, u.name as user_name, o.quote_id, i.*, o.doc_no as order_doc_no, q.doc_no as quote_doc_no
FROM invoices i 
	inner join orders o on i.order_id = o.id
	inner join quotes q on o.quote_id = q.id
    inner join users u on q.user_id = u.id
WHERE
	o.id = $1
order by i.id

WITH order_context AS (
    -- Obtenemos las facturas asociadas a la orden y metadatos de usuario/presupuesto
    SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.doc_no AS order_doc_no,
        q.doc_no AS quote_doc_no,
        i.id AS target_invoice_id,
        i.doc_no AS invoice_doc_no,
        i.currency AS invoice_currency,
        u.name AS user_name
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN invoices i ON i.order_id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN quotes q ON o.quote_id = q.id
    INNER JOIN users u ON i.user_id = u.id -- O q.user_id según prefieras
    WHERE o.id = $1 -- FILTRO: ID DE LA ORDEN
)

-- BLOQUE 1: PAGOS DIRECTOS
SELECT 
    oc.order_doc_no,
    oc.invoice_doc_no,
    'direct_payment' AS transaction_type,
    p.id AS transaction_id,
    p.created_at AS payment_date,
    COALESCE(p.converted_amount, p.amount) AS amount_applied,
    p.amount AS source_amount,
    p.currency AS source_currency,
    p.exchange_rate,
    pm.name AS payment_method_name, 
    pm.code AS payment_method_code,
    oc.invoice_currency,
    oc.quote_doc_no,
    oc.user_name,
    p.doc_no,
    oc.target_invoice_id AS invoice_id,
    oc.user_name
FROM order_context oc
JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = oc.target_invoice_id
LEFT JOIN payment_methods pm ON p.payment_method_id = pm.id

UNION ALL

-- BLOQUE 2: ASIGNACIONES DE PAGOS (ANTICIPOS/BILLETERA)
SELECT 
    oc.order_doc_no,
    oc.invoice_doc_no,
    'payment_allocation' AS transaction_type,
    pa.id AS transaction_id,
    pa.created_at AS payment_date,
    pa.target_amount AS amount_applied,
    pa.amount AS source_amount,
    orig_p.currency AS source_currency,
    pa.exchange_rate,
    pm.name AS payment_method_name,
    pm.code AS payment_method_code,
    oc.invoice_currency,
    oc.quote_doc_no,
    oc.user_name,
    null AS doc_no,
    oc.target_invoice_id AS invoice_id,
    oc.user_name
FROM order_context oc
JOIN payment_allocations pa ON pa.invoice_id = oc.target_invoice_id
JOIN payments orig_p ON pa.payment_id = orig_p.id
LEFT JOIN payment_methods pm ON orig_p.payment_method_id = pm.id

UNION ALL

-- BLOQUE 3: ASIGNACIONES DE NOTAS DE CRÉDITO
SELECT 
    oc.order_doc_no,
    oc.invoice_doc_no,
    'credit_note_allocation' AS transaction_type,
    ia.id AS transaction_id,
    ia.created_at AS payment_date,
    ia.target_amount AS amount_applied,
    ia.amount AS source_amount,
    nc.currency AS source_currency,
    ia.exchange_rate,
    'Credit Note' AS payment_method_name,
    'CN' AS payment_method_code,
    oc.invoice_currency,
    oc.quote_doc_no,
    oc.user_name,
    null AS doc_no,
    oc.target_invoice_id AS invoice_id,
    oc.user_name
FROM order_context oc
JOIN invoice_allocations ia ON ia.target_id = oc.target_invoice_id
JOIN invoices nc ON ia.source_id = nc.id

ORDER BY payment_date DESC;

WITH invoice_context AS (
    -- Contexto de la factura específica
    SELECT
        i.id AS target_invoice_id,
        i.doc_no AS invoice_doc_no,
        i.currency AS invoice_currency,
        u.name AS user_name,
        o.doc_no AS order_doc_no,
        q.doc_no AS quote_doc_no
    FROM invoices i
    INNER JOIN users u ON i.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN quotes q ON o.quote_id = q.id
    WHERE i.id = $1
)

-- BLOQUE 1: PAGOS DIRECTOS (Relación directa 1:1)
SELECT 
    ic.invoice_doc_no,
    'direct_payment' AS transaction_type,
    p.id AS transaction_id,
    p.created_at AS payment_date,
    ABS(COALESCE(p.converted_amount, p.amount)) AS amount_applied,
    ABS(p.amount) AS source_amount,
    p.currency AS source_currency,
    p.exchange_rate,
    pm.name AS payment_method_name, 
    pm.code AS payment_method_code,
    ic.invoice_currency,
    ic.order_doc_no,
    ic.quote_doc_no,
    p.doc_no AS doc_no,
    ic.target_invoice_id AS invoice_id,
    ic.user_name,
    p.external_id
FROM invoice_context ic
JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = ic.target_invoice_id
LEFT JOIN payment_methods pm ON p.payment_method_id = pm.id

UNION ALL

-- BLOQUE 2: ASIGNACIONES DE PAGOS (Anticipos/Wallet)
SELECT 
    ic.invoice_doc_no,
    'payment_allocation' AS transaction_type,
    pa.id AS transaction_id,
    pa.created_at AS payment_date,
    ABS(pa.target_amount) AS amount_applied,
    ABS(pa.amount) AS source_amount,
    orig_p.currency AS source_currency,
    pa.exchange_rate,
    pm.name AS payment_method_name,
    pm.code AS payment_method_code,
    ic.invoice_currency,
    ic.order_doc_no,
    ic.quote_doc_no,
    CONCAT(orig_p.doc_no, '-A', pa.id) AS doc_no, 
    ic.target_invoice_id AS invoice_id,
    ic.user_name,
    null AS external_id
FROM invoice_context ic
JOIN payment_allocations pa ON pa.invoice_id = ic.target_invoice_id
JOIN payments orig_p ON pa.payment_id = orig_p.id
LEFT JOIN payment_methods pm ON orig_p.payment_method_id = pm.id
WHERE (orig_p.invoice_id IS DISTINCT FROM ic.target_invoice_id)

UNION ALL

-- BLOQUE 3: ASIGNACIONES DE NOTAS DE CRÉDITO (Devoluciones/Compensaciones)
SELECT 
    ic.invoice_doc_no,
    'credit_note_allocation' AS transaction_type,
    ia.id AS transaction_id,
    ia.created_at AS payment_date,
    ABS(ia.target_amount) AS amount_applied,

    ic.quote_doc_no,
    CONCAT(nc.doc_no, '-A', ia.id) AS doc_no,

    ic.user_name,
    null AS external_id
FROM invoice_context ic
JOIN invoice_allocations ia ON ia.target_id = ic.target_invoice_id
JOIN invoices nc ON ia.source_id = nc.id

SELECT 
    q.id, 
    q.user_id, 
    u.name AS user_name, 
    q.total AS total_presupuesto, 
    q.status, 
    q.billing_status, 
    q.payment_status, 
    q.created_at, 
    q.currency, 
    q.doc_no, 
    q.exchange_rate, 
    q.notes,
    q.external_id,
    q.sede_id,
    q.doctor_id,
    
    -- 1. Monto Facturado: Suma de facturas (restando notas de crédito si existen)
    COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'invoice' THEN i.total ELSE -i.total END)
        FROM public.invoices i
        JOIN public.orders o ON i.order_id = o.id
        WHERE o.quote_id = q.id AND i.status != 'cancel'
    ), 0) AS monto_facturado,

    -- 2. Monto Pagado: Suma de todos los pagos asociados a las facturas de este presupuesto
    COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(p.amount)
        FROM public.payments p
        JOIN public.invoices i ON p.invoice_id = i.id
        JOIN public.orders o ON i.order_id = o.id
        WHERE o.quote_id = q.id AND i.status != 'cancel'
    ), 0) AS monto_pagado,

    -- 3. Cálculo de Pendientes (opcional pero muy útil para el frontend)
    (q.total - COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'invoice' THEN i.total ELSE -i.total END)
        FROM public.invoices i
        JOIN public.orders o ON i.order_id = o.id
        WHERE o.quote_id = q.id AND i.status != 'cancel'
    ), 0)) AS pendiente_facturar,

    (COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'invoice' THEN i.total ELSE -i.total END)
        FROM public.invoices i
        JOIN public.orders o ON i.order_id = o.id
        WHERE o.quote_id = q.id AND i.status != 'cancel'
    ), 0) - COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(p.amount)
        FROM public.payments p
        JOIN public.invoices i ON p.invoice_id = i.id
        JOIN public.orders o ON i.order_id = o.id
        WHERE o.quote_id = q.id AND i.status != 'cancel'
    ), 0)) AS pendiente_pago_facturado,

    COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_items

FROM public.quotes q 
INNER JOIN public.users u ON u.id = q.user_id
WHERE ($1 IS NULL OR q.is_sales = $1)
  AND ($2 IS NULL OR q.id = $2)
  AND ($3 IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(q.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= $3)
  AND ($4 IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(q.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= $4)
  AND ($7 IS NULL OR q.doc_no ILIKE '%' || $7 || '%'
        OR u.name ILIKE '%' || $7 || '%')
ORDER BY q.id DESC
LIMIT $5
OFFSET (($6 - 1) * $5);

-- CONSULTA DE BILLETERA / SALDOS POSITIVOS PARA FRONTEND
-- Convierte montos negativos de DB a magnitudes positivas para facilitar la lectura.

-- PARTE 1: ANTICIPOS (PAGOS SIN FACTURA)
SELECT 
    'payment' AS type,
    p.id AS source_id,
    p.is_sales,
    p.currency, 
    p.created_at AS date,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.method IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('Pago (', p.method, ')') 
        ELSE 'Pago a cuenta' 
    END AS description,
    p.amount AS original_total,
    COALESCE(SUM(pa.amount), 0) AS used_total,
    (p.amount - COALESCE(SUM(pa.amount), 0)) AS available_balance
FROM payments p
LEFT JOIN payment_allocations pa ON pa.payment_id = p.id
WHERE p.user_id = $1
  AND p.invoice_id IS NULL
  AND p.amount > 0
GROUP BY p.id, p.amount, p.is_sales, p.currency, p.created_at, p.method
HAVING (p.amount - COALESCE(SUM(pa.amount), 0)) > 0.01
UNION ALL

-- PARTE 2: NOTAS DE CRÉDITO
SELECT 
    'credit_note' AS type,
    i.id AS source_id,
    i.is_sales,
    i.currency,
    i.created_at AS date,
    COALESCE(i.invoice_ref, CONCAT('Nota de Crédito #', i.id)) AS description,

    -- 1. El total original (magnitud positiva del crédito a favor del cliente)
    ABS(i.total) AS original_total,
    
    -- 2. El uso real: Cruces a otras facturas (reducen el saldo)
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ia.amount) FROM invoice_allocations ia WHERE ia.source_id = i.id), 0) AS used_total,
    
    -- 3. Saldo Disponible: Valor NC MENOS las devoluciones de dinero MENOS los cruces a facturas
    (
        ABS(i.total) 
        - -- <--- CAMBIO 1: De "+" a "-" (Resta la devolución de la billetera)
        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ABS(pa.target_amount)) FROM payment_allocations pa WHERE pa.invoice_id = i.id), 0)
        - 
        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ia.amount) FROM invoice_allocations ia WHERE ia.source_id = i.id), 0)
    ) AS available_balance

FROM invoices i
WHERE i.user_id = $1
  AND i.type = 'credit_note' 
  AND i.status = 'booked'
  
  -- Filtro para no traer notas de crédito con saldo virtual agotado
  AND (
        ABS(i.total) 
        + 
        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ABS(pa.target_amount)) FROM payment_allocations pa WHERE pa.invoice_id = i.id), 0)
        - 
        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ia.amount) FROM invoice_allocations ia WHERE ia.source_id = i.id), 0)
  ) > 0.01

ORDER BY date DESC;

SELECT 
    ia.id AS allocation_id,
    CONCAT(src.doc_no, '-A', ia.id) AS doc_no,
    -- Datos del Origen (Source)
    src.doc_no AS origen_doc_no,
    src.type AS origen_tipo,
    -- Datos del Destino (Target)
    tgt.doc_no AS destino_doc_no,
    tgt.type AS destino_tipo,
    -- Datos del Monto
    ia.amount AS monto_asignado,
    ia.allocated_currency AS moneda,
    ia.exchange_rate AS tipo_cambio,
    ia.target_amount AS monto_en_destino,
    ia.created_at AS fecha_asignacion
FROM public.invoice_allocations ia
JOIN public.invoices src ON ia.source_id = src.id
JOIN public.invoices tgt ON ia.target_id = tgt.id
WHERE src.id = $1 OR tgt.id = $1
ORDER BY ia.created_at DESC;

SELECT 
    pa.id AS allocation_id,
    CONCAT(p.doc_no, '-A', pa.id) AS doc_no,
    -- Datos del Pago
    p.doc_no AS pago_doc_no,
    pm.code AS medio_pago,
    p.currency AS moneda_pago,
    -- Datos de la Factura afectada
    i.doc_no AS factura_doc_no,
    i.type AS factura_tipo,
    i.currency AS moneda_factura,
    -- Detalle de la aplicación
    pa.amount AS monto_desde_pago,
    pa.allocated_currency AS moneda_allocation,
    pa.exchange_rate AS tipo_cambio,
    pa.target_amount AS monto_aplicado_a_factura,
    pa.created_at AS fecha_aplicacion
FROM public.payment_allocations pa
JOIN public.payments p ON pa.payment_id = p.id
JOIN public.payment_methods pm ON p.payment_method_id = pm.id
JOIN public.invoices i ON pa.invoice_id = i.id
WHERE p.id = $1
ORDER BY pa.created_at DESC;

where q.id = $1

WITH target_payments AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.payments

),
deleted_movements AS (

    WHERE payment_id IN (SELECT id FROM target_payments)
    RETURNING id
)

WITH deleted_items AS (

    RETURNING id
)
DELETE FROM public.orders

RETURNING id, quote_id;

UPDATE public.quotes
SET status = 'draft', billing_status = 'not invoiced', payment_status = 'not_paid'

RETURNING id;

WITH deleted_items AS (

)

WITH deleted_movements AS (

    WHERE payment_id = $1
    RETURNING id

WITH deleted_allocations AS (
    DELETE FROM public.invoice_allocations
    WHERE source_id = $1

    WHERE invoice_id = $1
    RETURNING id
)

WITH child_invoices AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.invoices
    WHERE parent_id = $1
),
deleted_items AS (
    DELETE FROM public.invoice_items
    WHERE invoice_id IN (SELECT id FROM child_invoices)
    RETURNING id
)

parameters.content:
## Editar tratamiento con cobros aplicados

Reemplaza a `invoices/upsert` cuando la factura ya tiene pagos o notas de
crédito aplicados. No toca caja: solo reacomoda a qué factura está
imputado lo que ya se cobró.

Ver `docs/reconciliacion-allocations-edicion.md` (Flujo A) para el
razonamiento completo.

parameters.query:
SELECT id, payment_id AS origin_id, 'payment' AS origin_type, amount, allocated_currency,
       target_amount, exchange_rate, created_at
FROM public.payment_allocations
WHERE invoice_id = $1
ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC;

SELECT id, source_id AS origin_id, 'credit_note' AS origin_type, amount, allocated_currency,
       target_amount, exchange_rate, created_at
FROM public.invoice_allocations
WHERE target_id = $1
ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC;

DELETE FROM public.payment_allocations
WHERE invoice_id = $1;

DELETE FROM public.invoice_allocations
WHERE target_id = $1;

UPDATE public.invoices
SET total = (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total), 0)
    FROM public.invoice_items
    WHERE invoice_id = $1
)
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, total;

parameters.content:
## Editar pago con allocations

Reemplaza el enfoque de "deshacer y recrear" (payment/undo + invoice/payment):
hace un UPDATE en el lugar sobre el mismo id, reusa la validación de sesión
de caja de payments/edit (extendida a monto, no solo método), y reasigna
FIFO las allocations existentes contra el nuevo monto.

Ver docs/reconciliacion-allocations-edicion.md (Flujo B).

parameters.query:
SELECT id, invoice_id, amount, allocated_currency, target_amount, exchange_rate, created_at
FROM public.payment_allocations
WHERE payment_id = $1
ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC;

DELETE FROM public.payment_allocations
WHERE payment_id = $1;

SELECT p.*, pm.code AS payment_method_code
FROM public.payments p
LEFT JOIN public.payment_methods pm ON pm.id = p.payment_method_id
WHERE p.id = $1
LIMIT 1;
SELECT * FROM public.payment_methods WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1;

parameters.content:
## Forzar payment_state manualmente

Usado por "Finalizado" (fuerza a 'paid' sin importar paid_amount real) y por su
reversión (recalcula 'partial'/'unpaid' desde el frontend). Solo cambia
invoices.payment_state — no toca paid_amount ni ninguna allocation.

Ver docs/finalizado-manual-tratamiento.md.

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.invoices
SET payment_state = $1
WHERE id = $2
RETURNING id, payment_state;
